newsitem.title: USA: Sallie Mae, Chase form loan venture.
newsitem.headline: Sallie Mae, Chase form loan venture.

text.p: Sallie Mae and Chase Manhattan Corp said Monday they are creating a joint, student loan venture that would acquire Chase Manhattan's existing $2.6 billion student loan portfolio.
The venture would also acquire all future student loans originated by Chase and provide marketing services for Chase student loan products.
The companies said the agreement permits them to acquire each other's interest in the joint venture after the first six years.
Sallie Mae is the nation's largest funding source for insured education loans.
Chase is the largest originator in the guaranteed student loan program and last year originated approximately $1.8 billion of guaranteed education loans.
